description: Global monitoring table for every room. Displaying data from EAM, LanDB and giving a summary of the status of each room.

options.content: Conference Rooms

panels.description: This table summarizes each room’s availability and AV readiness, displaying building and site, capacity, whether it is in use right now, the next booking, aggregated AV health (online, degraded, offline), the most recent telemetry seen for devices in the room, and recent utilization within the dashboard’s time range. Start by filtering to a site or building, then sort by AV health or In use now to prioritize interventions. Clicking a room opens its room overview with device-level detail and booking context. “No AV data” or many devices marked unknown usually means missing telemetry or a network issue; verify cabling, power, or upstream monitoring before reassigning meetings. Use the time range to compare peak vs. quiet periods and to spot underused rooms. When capacity mismatches or frequent conflicts appear, coordinate with scheduling to adjust bookings or suggest alternative rooms.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  -- seed: all starting positions
  SELECT
    dp.position                                        AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno                                      AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset                                      AS parent_pos,
    0                                                  AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]   AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  -- walk up the parent chain
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar(64) = ANY (c.visited)   -- cycle guard
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- pick the DEEPEST (farthest) matching ancestor
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms_with_devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    room.equipmentno         AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.category            AS RoomCategory,
    room.commissiondate      AS RoomCommissionDate,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'                                   -- All
      OR ('${status:raw}' = '__none__' AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL) -- None
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')      -- selected values (comma-safe)
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    -- raw parts (X.Y.Z) for natural sorting
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    -- numeric prefixes and alpha suffixes for natural sort
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNo,
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  ConferenceRoom,
  RoomCategory,
  RoomCommissionDate,
  RoomStatus,
  CASE WHEN ConferenceRoomNo IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS GIS
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
  part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
  part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
  part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
  ConferenceRoomNo;

-- PG_DEVICES (room ↔ device equipmentno) with stable room_sort_rank
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb_up AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position                                           AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno                                         AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset                                         AS parent_pos,
    0                                                     AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]      AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,

    c.depth + 1,

    AND c.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (c.visited)

pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,

  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR ('${status:raw}' = '__none__' AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')
    )
),

-- build same natural-sort pieces as Query A
room_keys AS (
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo
  , CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms r
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo
  , ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num
  , regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num
  , regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num
  , regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM room_keys
),
-- produce a single numeric rank to carry through Grafana grouping
room_order AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo
  , ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
        part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
        part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
        ConferenceRoomNo
    ) AS room_sort_rank
  FROM ranked
),

down AS (
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo
  , p.equipmentno
  , 1                                                      AS depth
  , ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar(64)]::varchar(64)[]       AS visited
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = r.ConferenceRoomNo

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    d.ConferenceRoomNo
  , p.equipmentno
  , d.depth + 1
  , (d.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar(64))::varchar(64)[] AS visited
  FROM down d
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE d.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar(64) <> ALL (d.visited)
),
leafs AS (
  SELECT d.ConferenceRoomNo, d.equipmentno AS leaf_position
  FROM down d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions ch ON ch.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE ch.equipmentno IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo
, ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt     -- optional, for display
, ro.room_sort_rank          -- **carry this into Grafana**
, dev.equipmentno
FROM leafs l
JOIN room_order     ro  ON ro.ConferenceRoomNo = l.ConferenceRoomNo
JOIN eam_devices    dev ON dev.position        = l.leaf_position
JOIN eam_positions  pos ON pos.equipmentno     = l.leaf_position
-- no device/position status filter anymore
ORDER BY ro.room_sort_rank, ro.ConferenceRoomNo, dev.equipmentno;

    0                                                AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]         AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  -- walk up the parent chain
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)   -- cycle guard
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- pick the DEEPEST (farthest) matching ancestor
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms_with_devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    room.equipmentno         AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.category            AS RoomCategory,
    room.commissiondate      AS RoomCommissionDate,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR ('${status:raw}' = '__none__' AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNo
FROM ranked;

-- PG_DEVICES (room ↔ device equipmentno) with stable room_sort_rank
WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb_up AS (
  SELECT
    dp.position                                      AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno                                    AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset                                    AS parent_pos,
    0                                                AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]         AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar <> ALL (c.visited)
),
pos_to_room AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb_up c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT room.equipmentno AS ConferenceRoomNo
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'
      OR ('${status:raw}' = '__none__' AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL)
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')
    )
),

-- build same natural-sort pieces as Query A
room_keys AS (
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo
  , CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt
  , split_part(split_part(r.ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms r
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo
  , ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num
  , regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num
  , regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf
  , NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num
  , regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM room_keys
),
-- produce a single numeric rank to carry through Grafana grouping
room_order AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo
  , ConferenceRoomNoFmt
  , DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        part1_num NULLS LAST, part1_suf,
        part2_num NULLS LAST, part2_suf,
        part3_num NULLS LAST, part3_suf,
        ConferenceRoomNo
    ) AS room_sort_rank
  FROM ranked
),

down AS (
  SELECT
    r.ConferenceRoomNo
  , p.equipmentno
  , 1                                              AS depth
  , ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]       AS visited
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = r.ConferenceRoomNo
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    d.ConferenceRoomNo
  , p.equipmentno
  , d.depth + 1
  , (d.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM down d
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE d.depth < 100
    AND p.equipmentno::varchar <> ALL (d.visited)
),
leafs AS (
  SELECT d.ConferenceRoomNo, d.equipmentno AS leaf_position
  FROM down d
  LEFT JOIN eam_positions ch ON ch.parentasset = d.equipmentno
  WHERE ch.equipmentno IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ro.ConferenceRoomNo
, ro.ConferenceRoomNoFmt     -- optional, for display
, ro.room_sort_rank          -- **carry this into Grafana**
, dev.equipmentno
FROM leafs l
JOIN room_order     ro  ON ro.ConferenceRoomNo = l.ConferenceRoomNo
JOIN eam_devices    dev ON dev.position        = l.leaf_position
JOIN eam_positions  pos ON pos.equipmentno     = l.leaf_position
-- no device/position status filter anymore
ORDER BY ro.room_sort_rank, ro.ConferenceRoomNo, dev.equipmentno;

WITH RECURSIVE
device_positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.position
  FROM eam_devices d
  WHERE d.position IS NOT NULL
),
climb AS (
  -- seed: all starting positions
  SELECT
    dp.position                                      AS start_pos,
    p.equipmentno                                    AS cur_pos,
    p.parentasset                                    AS parent_pos,
    0                                                AS depth,
    ARRAY[p.equipmentno::varchar]::varchar[]         AS visited
  FROM device_positions dp
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = dp.position

  UNION ALL

  -- walk up the parent chain
  SELECT
    c.start_pos,
    p.equipmentno,
    p.parentasset,
    c.depth + 1,
    (c.visited || p.equipmentno::varchar)::varchar[] AS visited
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions p ON p.equipmentno = c.parent_pos
  WHERE c.parent_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND c.depth < 100
    AND NOT p.equipmentno::varchar = ANY (c.visited)   -- cycle guard
),
pos_to_room AS (
  -- pick the DEEPEST (farthest) matching ancestor
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.start_pos)
    c.start_pos,
    c.cur_pos AS room_no
  FROM climb c
  JOIN eam_positions rp ON rp.equipmentno = c.cur_pos
  WHERE rp.eqclass = 'AVR'
    AND rp.category IN ('AV-VCR','AV-VIS','AV-MRO')
  ORDER BY c.start_pos, c.depth DESC, c.cur_pos
),
rooms_with_devices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    room.equipmentno         AS ConferenceRoomNo,
    room.equipmentdesc       AS ConferenceRoom,
    room.category            AS RoomCategory,
    room.commissiondate      AS RoomCommissionDate,
    room.assetstatus_display AS RoomStatus
  FROM pos_to_room pr
  JOIN eam_positions room ON room.equipmentno = pr.room_no
  WHERE
    (
      '${status:raw}' = '__all'                                   -- All
      OR ('${status:raw}' = '__none__' AND room.assetstatus_display IS NULL) -- None
      OR room.assetstatus_display ~ ('^(' || '${status:regex}' || ')$')      -- selected values (comma-safe)
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    ConferenceRoomNo,
    CONCAT(
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1), '/',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2), '-',
      split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3)
    ) AS ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
    ConferenceRoom,
    RoomCategory,
    RoomCommissionDate,
    RoomStatus,
    -- raw parts (X.Y.Z) for natural sorting
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',1) AS part1_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',2) AS part2_txt,
    split_part(split_part(ConferenceRoomNo,'-',2),'.',3) AS part3_txt
  FROM rooms_with_devices
  GROUP BY ConferenceRoomNo, ConferenceRoom, RoomCategory, RoomCommissionDate, RoomStatus
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    -- numeric prefixes and alpha suffixes for natural sort
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part1_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part1_num,
    regexp_replace(part1_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part1_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part2_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part2_num,
    regexp_replace(part2_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part2_suf,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(part3_txt, '\D.*$', ''), '')::int AS part3_num,
    regexp_replace(part3_txt, '^\d+', '')                    AS part3_suf
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  ConferenceRoomNoFmt,
  RoomCommissionDate
FROM ranked;
